evidence.note: Serif headline, sans subtitle, italic byline on a soft blurred-blob backdrop; generous whitespace, nothing colliding.
Three-node reward loop with colour-coded honest/cheat arrows and check badges; definition tile sits directly under the diagram it explains; left-column body text balanced against it.
Insight overlay uses the same INSIGHT label + serif body treatment as on s-4 and s-5, with the slide blurred behind it.
Numbered timeline, server-boundary diagram and sourced quote tile share consistent label caps, serif quote styling and card shadows; layout reads cleanly in three columns.
Large card covers the timeline column; its blurred left edge shows behind the card and a second quote tile floats far right, making the step slightly busy.

Densest step: folder grid, scorer box, eye badge, red/black dots and a 'never read transcripts' caption that runs past the servers panel edge toward the internet column; crowded relative to other slides though nothing is unreadable.
Three evenly sized takeaway cards with matching serif headings, bullets, italic pull-quotes and source links; consistent and uncluttered.
Closing slide reuses the title slide's backdrop and serif treatment, bookending the deck.

rationale: Typography, card components, labels, overlays and the shared incident diagram are applied consistently across every slide, and the diagrams carry the story rather than decorating it. The late s-5 steps are noticeably more crowded than the rest (dense folder/scorer cluster, caption crossing the panel edge, research card overlapping the timeline). That fits level 4: considered throughout with one slide below the rest.
